name: MusicScore
description: Music scores are written representations of music and contain rich information about musical components. The visual information on music scores includes notes, rests, staff lines, clefs, dynamics, and articulations. This visual information in music scores contains more semantic information than audio and symbolic representations of music. Previous music score datasets have limited sizes and are mainly designed for optical music recognition (OMR). There is a lack of research on creating a large-scale benchmark dataset for music modeling and generation. In this work, we propose MusicScore, a large-scale music score dataset collected and processed from the International Music Score Library Project (IMSLP). MusicScore consists of image-text pairs, where the image is a page of a music score and the text is the metadata of the music. reputation: A recent large-scale music-score benchmark that is useful for multimodal music understanding, but it is still new and not yet widely established as a standard benchmark.
notes: Primarily a dataset/benchmark for music-score image-text pairs; likely limited community adoption so far and no widely standardized leaderboard.
